title: llama.cpp Server Provider Options
description: Options for the remote/llamacpp embedding provider. It targets a llama.cpp `llama-server` and runs a tokenizer-aware truncation pre-pass (via the server's native /tokenize endpoint) because llama-server never truncates embedding input.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible root of the llama-server including the version segment, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1. A trailing slash is ignored.

tokenizer_base_url.description: Server root used for the native /tokenize endpoint (which lives outside /v1). Defaults to base_url with one trailing /v1 segment removed.

max_input_tokens.description: Total token budget per input INCLUDING the model's special tokens (512 for BGE / BERT models). Inputs that would exceed it are truncated client-side to the first max_input_tokens-1 ids plus the trailing special token. Must not exceed the server's --ubatch-size or --ctx-size.

embedding_dimensions.description: Expected embedding vector width (384 for bge-small-en-v1.5). Responses with a different width are rejected.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding a bearer token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer` on every request. Omit when llama-server runs without --api-key.

request_timeout_secs.description: Per-HTTP-request timeout for the /tokenize and /v1/embeddings calls. The alias-level `timeout` still bounds the whole embed call.
